text:
Maya Patel: thinking about adding a 'Preview logs' action on route pages to surface a single sampled req/res for quick debugging without turning on full inspect mode. big question: PII safety.
Aj Rivera: love the idea. requirement: preview must be explicitly sampled and masked, and we should show a redaction confidence indicator. propose buckets: HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW. HIGH -> pseudonymize, MEDIUM -> partial mask, LOW -> full redact. :mag:
Sam Wu: two operational concerns: 1) preview could be abused and blow past tenant quotas if people click a lot; 2) preview hitting runtime could increase tail latency unless routed specially. recommend a per-tenant preview_budget and separate telemetry counter.
Tess O'Neil: UX: show why each span was redacted (e.g. 'regex:SSN', 'ner:EMAIL') in a hover. also add a tiny confidence pill next to each redacted span so engineers know whether to escalate.
Aj Rivera: implementation idea: sampler hint in request metadata so sampler can apply quota-aware logic. example hint: `sampler_hint=preview_low_confidence`, `preview_ttl=10s`, `actor=console`. sampler can fallback to mask_and_sample if budget exhausted.
Maya Patel: sample preview wireframe:
```
Request: {"user_input":"my ssn is 123-45-6789 and email is maya@example.com"}
PreviewResponse: {"response":"sorry, can't help with that"}
AuditView:
  user_input: "my ssn is [REDACTED:PII:LOW_CONF] and email is [PSEUD:email:HIGH_CONF]"
  redaction_reasons: ["regex:ssn","ner:EMAIL"]
```
Jordan (eng-sre): for incidents we need a breakglass to see unredacted previews, but it must be tightly audited and time-limited. prefer issuing single-use breakglass tokens that are logged to runbook and emit telemetry.
Sam Wu: routing: previews should prefer cached/quantized variants (routing.priority=background_preview) and avoid premium instances. also honor prefix caching to reduce load.
Aj Rivera: API hooks: add headers `X-Preview-Mode: <level>` and `X-Preview-Request-Id`. sampler checks header, consults tenant.preview_budget, returns masked sample or 403/preview-unavailable if budget exhausted. UI shows "Preview unavailable: budget" state.
Tess O'Neil: UX detail: make previews ephemeral and non-cacheable, and offer a "request audit" button that opens a support ticket instead of auto-unredacting. keep peek gated.
Maya Patel: question: should previews include embeddings or any derivative telemetry? my vote: never surface embeddings or model-internal vectors in preview; only sanitized text and redaction metadata.
Jordan (eng-sre): +1 on no embeddings. telemetry event to emit: {preview_level, tenant_id, route, preview_outcome: shown|blocked|audited}. keep telemetry minimal to avoid leaking PII.
Aj Rivera: pseudocode sampler rule (proto):
```
sampler_rules:
  - name: preview_quota_check
    header: X-Preview-Mode
    budget_key: tenant.preview_budget
    fallback: mask_and_sample
    routing_hint: prefer_cached_variant
```
Maya Patel: proposed canary: server header + sampler budget + console button, no breakglass initially. Aj/Jordan pair for 2-week spike; I can do the UI scaffold.
Aj Rivera: will stub the sampler change, add header handling, and write quota-exhaustion tests.
Jordan (eng-sre): will add runbook note for breakglass token flow and add the minimal telemetry event.
AuditBot: created ticket INF-8742 for "console preview + preview_budget" and linked PR-221 for runbook.
Tess O'Neil: final UX ask: copy for confidence pills and a small shield icon tooltip when content is partially masked.
Maya Patel: action items recap: Aj -> sampler spike + tests; Jordan -> runbook + telemetry; Maya -> UI scaffold; Tess -> copy + icons. sync Thu 10am to review canary. thanks! :raised_hands:
